description: Open-source, Jev-compatible API that mimics Jev's fast parallel typed-decision behavior on an open model.
how_used_jev: Not Jev itself: runs Qwen3.6-35B-A3B behind an SGLang radix cache to approximate Jev's prefill reuse and parallel System One-style generation, benchmarked at 64 tasks in under 1 second.
author: @ekzhang1

replaces.notes: self-hosted approximation on an open model, not a drop-in - own accuracy/calibration unverified against Jev

benchmark.notes: uses SGLang radix cache for prefill reuse
